name: IncidentPilot demo - small office web server under attack

history.comment: Yesterday: IT's authorized weekly Nmap scan. Analyst dismissed it as a false positive -> Pilot learns from this.

alerts.description: The source IP accessed 12 different ports in 5 seconds (threshold 5). Ports: 21, 22, 23, 25, 53, 80, 110, 143, 443, 445, 3306, 8080.

history.notes: Authorized weekly vulnerability scan by the IT team (Nessus/Nmap box). Expected every week.

steps.comment: Attacker 1 - reconnaissance: fast port scan of the web server
Attacker 1 - exploitation: SQL injection on the login and product pages
payloads: GET /products?id=1 UNION SELECT username,password FROM users HTTP/1.1

steps.comment: Attacker 2 - XSS attempts on the search page
IT scanner again - same as yesterday's dismissed false positive
Attacker 3 - password guessing on the IncidentPilot dashboard login
Unknown host - traffic spike (could be a flood or a misbehaving backup job)
